title: Rational small-bias Fourier estimate
statement: Let the input consist of a dimension $n>0$, positive integers $a,b$ with $2a\le b$, and an integer Fourier bound $B\ge1$. For each coordinate set $U\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ and each sign-valued answer indexed by the sample set, define the estimate to be the empirical Fourier coefficient on $U$ of the paired samples: the signs obtained by encoding the generated binary vectors, paired with their answers.
hypotheses_covered: one sign-valued answer for each sample
